title: Web Animation by @osmosupply: Meet the Draw SVG Page Transition Template. It animates an <svg> path
notes:
Meet the Draw SVG Page Transition Template. It animates an <svg> path with a smooth draw effect, then wipes it away to reveal the next page. Replace the path with your own and experiment freely. Part of the Osmo Page Transition Course http://osmo.supply/ptc

Designer: @osmosupply. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
